title: Sheet Pan Full English
subtitle: English breakfast components roasted and finished on one pan.
description: Bacon, sausage, tomatoes, mushrooms, and eggs roasted on sheet pans — full English breakfast without ten pans on the stove.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 400°F. Line two sheet pans with foil and lightly oil. Arrange sausages on one pan and bacon on the other with space between pieces for even rendering.

steps.title: Roast meats
steps.instruction: Roast sausages 15 minutes, turning once, until internal temperature reaches 160°F. Roast bacon 12–15 minutes until crisp. Hold warm tented with foil.

steps.title: Roast veg
steps.instruction: Toss tomatoes and mushrooms with oil, salt, and pepper on a clean sheet pan. Roast at 425°F until tomatoes collapse and mushrooms brown, about 12 minutes.

steps.title: Warm beans and toast
steps.instruction: Simmer baked beans in a pot over low heat, stirring occasionally. Toast bread until golden. Keep beans and toast warm on the line.

steps.title: Fry eggs and assemble
steps.instruction: Fry eggs in butter over medium until whites are set (165°F) and yolks are runny. Plate each serving with sausage, bacon, beans, roasted veg, toast, and a fried egg.

stationWorkflow: Separate bacon and sausages on different pans so bacon fat does not steam the links.
Warm beans on the back burner while the oven handles veg—timing is everything.
Fry eggs in two skillets in parallel so ten plates finish within the same 5-minute window.
cleanupNotes: Drain bacon fat from foil into a container once cooled—never pour grease down the drain.
Discard foil liners with rendered fat to cut scrub time on sheet pans.
leftovers: Reheat roasted components on a sheet pan at 350°F; fry fresh eggs separately.
Mash leftover beans and sausage into a toast topping with cheddar for quick rarebit-style bites.

adaptable.label: Gluten-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use a certified gluten-free bun/bread and toast on a separate, clean surface.
